settings.languageNote: Choose the language for all of Statly.
settings.autoUpdateNote: Lets Anki's built-in updater include Statly in its automatic checks.
settings.uninstallNote: Removes Statly through Anki's add-on manager. Your cards, notes and decks stay unchanged.
settings.newsBody: Statly has been rebuilt from the ground up: a faster dashboard, a more exact statistics engine and a foundation for much more. Your collection stays local, and Statly reads only the review data it needs.
settings.counterColorsNote: Color New, Learning and Due on Anki's deck overview.
settings.wallpaperEnableNote: The image is shown only on the deck overview.
settings.wallpaperLimits: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 20 MB and 40 megapixels. Images are optimized and stored locally.
settings.deckHeatmapNote: Also show your learning activity on Anki's normal deck overview.
settings.brandAnimationNote: Show a subtle ten-second animation on the Statly link in Anki's toolbar.
settings.resetDashboardNote: Restore the standard view with the most important statistics.
settings.aiBody: Your AI assistant now lives in a panel beside the page. Its settings are there too, so everything stays in one place.
settings.shortcutPress: Press a key combination. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
settings.supportBody: Links to the project and feedback page follow with the public release. Your cards, notes and review history are never transferred.
settings.sponsorTitle: Simple in design. With a story that fits you.
settings.sponsorBody: Oldschool Timeless combines minimal, timeless designs with small stories. The clothing is made for everyday life.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.note: Theme and counter colors for Statly and the deck overview.

wallpaper.title: Wallpaper
wallpaper.note: A custom background image for Anki's deck overview. Cards and decks remain unchanged.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.note: Adjust Statly's home page and Anki's deck overview.

ai.title: AI
ai.note: Your own AI assistant, in a panel beside the page.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.note: Choose an action and press the key combination you want.

support.title: Statly Support
support.note: Project and feedback in one place.

supporters.title: Supporters
supporters.note: Thanks to everyone who makes Statly possible.

sponsor.title: Oldschool Timeless
sponsor.note: Statly is sponsored by Oldschool Timeless.

mobile.title: iPhone & iPad
mobile.note: See your dashboard in AnkiMobile and AnkiDroid.

settings.jojoRole: The idea for the Frutiger Aero theme.
settings.fullscreenNote: Statly fills the whole screen when it opens.
settings.backgroundsNote: A picture behind your dashboard, chosen for each device. Phones and tablets get it with the card.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Your cards are not affected. Reloading usually fixes this.

templateNotes.dailyGoal: A ring that fills up towards today's goal.
templateNotes.streak: Your current streak on a colorful tile.
templateNotes.weekly: Your reviews of the last seven days as a chart.

library.noFavorites: Mark widgets with the star to find them here.

welcome.title: Welcome to Statly
welcome.body: See your progress. Your collection stays yours: Statly only reads statistics and never changes your cards.
welcome.terms: I accept the license. Statly is provided as is, without warranty.
welcome.themeNote: You can change this at any time in Settings.

rating.title: Enjoying Statly?
rating.body: A rating on AnkiWeb helps other Anki users discover the add-on. It takes less than a minute.

calendar.invalid: Please enter a valid date as dd.mm.yyyy.

editor.needsName: Give your widget a name first.
editor.name: Name
editor.otherSizeNote: You are at {{w}} × {{h}} cells. Elements you move here keep this arrangement for this size only.
editor.resizeWidget: Drag to resize. Hold Alt (⌥) to grow on both sides.
editor.rotate: Turn the element. Hold Shift for steps of 15 degrees.

start.title: Let's build this widget
start.body: The AI prepared a widget of {{w}} by {{h}} cells. We add it piece by piece, so you can do it yourself next time. You can drag any corner to change its size.

text.title: A text
text.body: Texts label your widget. You find them on the left under Blocks. On the right you change the wording, size and color.

metric.title: A metric
metric.body: A metric shows a live number from Anki. On the right you choose which number and for which time range.

chart.title: A chart
chart.body: Charts show how something develops. On the right you choose the data, the time range and bars or a line.

progress.title: A progress display
progress.body: It fills up towards a goal. On the right you set the goal and choose a ring or a bar.

heatmap.title: A heatmap
heatmap.body: It shows your year at a glance. Drag it to move it, and pull a corner to resize it.

shape.title: A shape
shape.body: Shapes structure a widget. On the right you change their color and corners.

media.title: A picture
media.body: Pictures and videos make a widget yours. Videos stay on the desktop, pictures also reach phones.

finish.title: That's it!
finish.body: Change anything you like, then press Save at the top. Your widget lands in the Widget Library.

mobile.step1: Statly keeps a single dashboard card in its own deck, Statly Dashboard.
mobile.step2: The card reaches your phone with your normal Anki sync.
mobile.step3: On your phone, open the deck and tap Study. The dashboard appears. There is nothing to answer.
mobile.offNote: Your collection stays exactly as it is until you switch this on.
mobile.removeNote: Removes the card, and its deck if nothing else is in there. Statly makes a backup first. An empty note type called Statly Dashboard stays, because deleting it would force a full sync.
mobile.confirm1: Anki makes a backup of your collection first.
mobile.confirm2: Statly adds one deck, one note type and one card. Your own cards stay untouched.
mobile.confirm3: The card updates when you return to the deck overview and before a sync.
mobile.limits: The card shows the state of your last desktop sync. Cards you study on your phone appear after your computer has synced again. Custom widgets stay on the desktop for now.

ai.title: Statly AI
ai.intro: Ask about your learning, or have widgets and your dashboard adjusted. Nothing changes until you accept it.
ai.example1: How much did I study the day before yesterday?
ai.example2: Which deck did I work on most this month?
ai.example3: Create a widget showing my study time today.

notices.refused: The model declined to answer this.
notices.length: The answer was cut off because it became too long.
notices.steps: This took too many steps and was stopped.

errors.not_configured: Choose a service and a model first.
errors.key_missing: This service needs an API key.
errors.consent_needed: Please confirm what gets sent first.
errors.bad_url: This address is not allowed. Use https, or http on this computer.
errors.key_invalid: The service does not accept this API key. A chat subscription does not include API access.
errors.no_access: This key has no access to that.
errors.model_missing: The service does not know this model.
errors.rate_limited: The service has too many requests right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.provider_down: The service is having trouble right now. Please try again.
errors.unreachable: The service cannot be reached. Is it running, and are you online?
errors.no_tool_support: This model cannot use tools, so it cannot read your statistics. Please choose another model.
errors.bad_response: The service sent an answer Statly cannot read.
errors.chat_too_long: This chat has become very long. Please start a new one.
errors.context_too_small: This model has too little room. In LM Studio, load it with a context length of at least 8000, or choose a larger model.
errors.no_credit: Your credit with this service is used up. Top it up in your account there.
errors.keys_locked: Your keys are locked. Enter your password first.

proposal.applied: Accepted. You can undo this under Changes.

history.note: Everything an AI changed. Each entry can be undone.

setup.keySession: In memory only, until Anki closes
setup.keyNote: Your system's keychain encrypts the key. Statly never shows it again, writes it to no file, holds it in memory only during an answer and sends it only to this service. Deleting Statly deletes it too.
setup.keyNoteSession: Your system has no keychain Statly can use. The key therefore stays in memory until Anki closes and never goes into a file.
setup.noTools: This model cannot use tools, so it cannot read your statistics.
setup.keyHelp: How do I get an API key?
setup.keyHelpOpen: Open the key page of this service
setup.keyHelpCreate: Create a new key and copy it.
setup.keyHelpNote: A chat subscription does not include API access. API use is paid separately, by what you use.
setup.betaNote: This connection could not be tested with a real key yet.
setup.keyLimitNote: Tip: create a separate key just for Statly and set a spending limit with the service. That limits what a lost key could ever cost.
setup.keySavedPassword: Encrypted in your keychain and locked with your password

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.note: Claude, with your own API key

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.help: Start Ollama, then load the models here.

lmstudio.name: LM Studio
lmstudio.help: In LM Studio, start the local server and load a model.

consent.title: What gets sent to this service
consent.sent: Your questions and the statistics needed to answer them, such as review counts and study time.
consent.names: Names of your widgets. Deck names and card contents only with your permission, which the AI asks for when it needs them.
consent.never: Nothing else from your collection, and it can never change cards.
consent.terms: The service's own terms apply, and you pay for what you use through your own account.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.keepChatsNote: Stored only on this computer, up to the last 40 chats. Turning this off deletes them.

external.title: Allow external AI apps
external.note: Lets apps on this computer, such as Claude Desktop, read your statistics and suggest changes.
external.step1: Save the connection file and open it in your AI app.
external.step2: Create a connection code and paste it there.
external.step3: Leave Anki open while you use it.
external.codeOnce: Shown only now. A new code cancels this one.
external.portBusy: Another program is using Statly's port. Create a new code to pick another one.
external.limits: Reachable only from this computer. Apps on your phone cannot connect.
external.permissionsNote: External apps may then see what the chat is allowed to see. They can never ask for more by themselves.

auto.title: Automatic mode
auto.note: The AI changes widgets, the dashboard and appearance without asking.
auto.externalNote: Lets external apps apply changes without asking, too.
auto.warning1: The AI then changes widgets, your dashboard and appearance settings without asking you.
auto.warning2: A manipulated deck name, widget name or shared file can steer it into changes you never wanted.
auto.warning3: Cards, notes, API keys, the phone card and this switch stay locked, and every change can be undone under Changes.
auto.active: Automatic mode is on: changes apply without asking.

cards.title: Allow reading your cards?
cards.body: The AI wants to read card contents to answer this. They go to the chosen service. It can never change a card.
cards.settingNote: Searching cards and reading their contents. Off means the AI asks first.

decks.title: Allow seeing your deck names?
decks.body: The AI wants to see the names of your decks. Without this, it only sees Deck 1, Deck 2 and so on.
decks.settingNote: Off means the AI asks first and sees numbers instead of names.

review.title: It works!
review.body: This connection is still in beta and could not be tested with every service. If you are happy, a short positive review on AnkiWeb helps a lot, and you can mention which service you use.

chats.empty: Your earlier chats will show up here.

keyLock.title: Extra password for your keys
keyLock.note: Other Anki add-ons can then no longer read your key from the keychain unnoticed. You enter the password once after each Anki start.
keyLock.limit: After you unlock, a hostile add-on could still catch the key. Only install add-ons you trust.
keyLock.unavailable: This needs your system's keychain, which Statly can't reach here.
keyLock.lockedNote: Enter your password. The keys stay unlocked until Anki closes.
keyLock.forgotNote: Nobody can recover it. You can delete your saved keys and the password, then add your keys again.

notes.enable: If you forget this password, nobody can get your keys back. You would have to delete them and add them again.
notes.disable: Your keys stay in the keychain, just without the extra password.
notes.change: Your keys stay as they are. Only the password changes.

devices.automatic: Worked out from your desktop dashboard. Change anything here and this device keeps its own arrangement.
devices.arranged: You arranged this device yourself. New desktop widgets join at the bottom.
devices.help: This is what your card shows. Drag tiles to move them, pull a corner to resize, or click a tile to change it.
devices.settingsNote: Statly works this out from your dashboard. You can adjust it in the dashboard's edit mode.
devices.videoNote: Videos stay on the desktop. On phones and tablets, a note takes their place.
devices.offerTitle: Show this on your phone too?
devices.offerBody: Statly adds one dashboard card that travels with your normal Anki sync, in its own deck. Anki makes a backup first, and your own cards stay untouched.

unsaved.title: Save your changes?
unsaved.body: You have changes that are not saved yet.
unsaved.closeWindow: You have unsaved changes. Close Statly anyway?

ankiStats.needsFsrs: This needs FSRS, which you can turn on in Anki's deck options.
